name: Methi Malai Murgh (Creamy Fenugreek Chicken)
method: braise (marinate, then brown aromatics and simmer chicken covered in a cream-yogurt gravy until reduced)
why: Distinctive North Indian cream braise (chicken simmered covered in a hung-curd/cream gravy scented with dried fenugreek until the gravy reduces) with no analog in the catalog - not another tomato curry (madras/jalfrezi/rogan josh) or coconut curry (korma/kadai/rendang).
